page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance provides 96 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, delivering a total of 96 vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, which supports high-throughput data transfers. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the instance. The lack of local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance for workloads that rely entirely on CPU processing and network-based storage systems.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.g7ne.24xlarge offers high compute density with dedicated physical cores, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for enterprise workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without hyperthreading interference. The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio and high network bandwidth make this instance suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and distributed database nodes that require high network throughput but do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
